# ConstantCanBeUsed

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Language level migration](/rules/#language-level-migration) · PhpStorm name: `ConstantCanBeUsedInspection`

Some function calls only return a value that PHP already exposes as a
constant (`PHP_VERSION`, `PHP_SAPI`, `M_PI`, …), and comparisons of
`PHP_VERSION` via `version_compare()` or OS sniffing on `PHP_OS` have cheaper,
clearer constant-based equivalents (`PHP_VERSION_ID`, `PHP_OS_FAMILY`).

## Example

::: code-group

```php{4,5,7,12,13,14,15,26} [Before]
<?php
use function pi;

$sapi = php_sapi_name();
$ver  = \phpversion();
$self = get_class();
$area = 2 * pi() * $r;

$ext  = phpversion('intl');
$host = php_uname('n');

$a = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '8', 'lt');
$b = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, "7.4.33", 'ge');
$c = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '8.2.0', 'eq');
$d = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '5.6.4', '<>');

$e = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '8.2.0-RC1', '>=');
$f = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '10.1', '>=');
$g = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '8.2');
$h = version_compare($other, '8.2', '>=');
$i = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '8.2', 'GE');
$j = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '8.2', '==');

class Widget {
    public function name() {
        return get_class();
    }
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
use function pi;

$sapi = PHP_SAPI;
$ver  = PHP_VERSION;
$self = get_class();
$area = 2 * M_PI * $r;

$ext  = phpversion('intl');
$host = php_uname('n');

$a = PHP_VERSION_ID < 80000;
$b = PHP_VERSION_ID >= 70433;
$c = PHP_VERSION_ID === 80200;
$d = PHP_VERSION_ID !== 50604;

$e = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '8.2.0-RC1', '>=');
$f = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '10.1', '>=');
$g = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '8.2');
$h = version_compare($other, '8.2', '>=');
$i = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '8.2', 'GE');
$j = version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '8.2', '==');

class Widget {
    public function name() {
        return __CLASS__;
    }
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: Use the PHP_SAPI constant instead of this call.</li>
<li>line 5: Use the PHP_VERSION constant instead of this call.</li>
<li>line 7: Use the M_PI constant instead of this call.</li>
<li>line 12: Replace with &#39;PHP_VERSION_ID &lt; 80000&#39;.</li>
<li>line 13: Replace with &#39;PHP_VERSION_ID &gt;= 70433&#39;.</li>
<li>line 14: Replace with &#39;PHP_VERSION_ID === 80200&#39;.</li>
<li>line 15: Replace with &#39;PHP_VERSION_ID !== 50604&#39;.</li>
<li>line 26: Use the __CLASS__ constant instead of this call.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ConstantCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ConstantCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection ConstantCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
